name: ExampleVent-fictional
description: Vendor-style catalog for a FICTIONAL manufacturer 'ExampleVent'. Shows product-code ids, per-series size windows, and two deliberate overrides of ids in example-generic.json (rect-elbow-r1.0 and vav-box). All numbers are invented to look plausible; this is not real vendor data and must not be used for design.

fittings.source: ExampleVent RE series R = 1.0 W (fictional example - not real vendor data)
fittings.notes: Same id as example-generic.json: when merged after it, this entry replaces the generic one in place and Merge() records a warning.

fittings.notes: Same id as example-generic.json; overrides it on merge.
